Modern Maps Are All Wonrg (a little long but worth it)
Thanks a lot! I saw it a few days ago and I was quite surprised; I had always thought of Russia as being significantly larger than it actually is.

It's not that modern maps are wrong, it's that modern maps are built so that the latitude and longitude lines are parallel Which makes navigating easier when plotting a straight course.

Sailers and merchants were not really concerned with Africa vs Greenland in terms of surface area, but in terms of 'can I hit it'.

Yeah I get that; but sailors have modern navigational equipment nowadays, yet we still persist in using these very odd projections of the Earth. I understand full well that we can't accurately superimpose a sphere onto a flat surface, so we must have these weird views of our planet, I just think people should be aware of the actual sizes of countries, especially in comparison to each other.
I figured it was common knowledge that the Mercator Projection wasn't very accurate. I haven't seen it actually used in a classroom or textbook in a long time.
